modmenu.descriptionTranslation.ls_tweaks: Quality-of-life tweaks for inventory management, sorting, and auto-refill.
config.ls_tweaks.slotlock_enabled.toolti: Enable locking of player slots via Ctrl-Click (inventory/creative only).
config.ls_tweaks.slotlock_showIcons.tool: Render a small lock overlay on locked slots.
config.ls_tweaks.slotlock_stopQuickMoves: When ON, locked slots are ignored by quick-move, quick-stack and sorting.
While holding Shift, dragging across items will quick-move each one.
config.ls_tweaks.keybind_sort_key.toolti: Select the key used to trigger sorting.
config.ls_tweaks.keybind_open_config_key: Select the key used to open the config UI.
config.ls_tweaks.ui_show_sorting_buttons: Show sorting buttons on inventory and container screens.
config.ls_tweaks.sorting_minimizedDispla: Minimize The Display Of The Sorting Buttons To Only Show The Default Button
config.ls_tweaks.sorting_default_sort_mo: Change The Default Sort Mode When Using The Keybind Or Minimized Display
config.ls_tweaks.refill_enabled.tooltip: Automatically refill hotbar stacks from your inventory.
config.ls_tweaks.refill_strictNbt.toolti: Require exact NBT match when refilling (prevents variant mix-ups).
config.ls_tweaks.quickstack_enabled.tool: Enable Quick-Stack actions to move items between inventories.
config.ls_tweaks.quickstack_allowContain: Allow Quick-Stack actions from container to inventory.
config.ls_tweaks.ui_show_quickstack_butt: Show Quick-Stack buttons on inventory and container screens.
ls_tweaks.recipe_browser.title: Recipe Browser
config.ls_tweaks_recipe_viewer.enabled.t: Enable or disable the recipe viewer overlay
config.ls_tweaks_recipe_viewer.show_reci: Show recipe names in output tooltips
config.ls_tweaks_recipe_viewer.buttons_p: Position of the page navigation buttons
config.ls_tweaks_recipe_viewer.fill_mode: How the overlay fills the screen space
config.ls_tweaks_recipe_viewer.fixed_col: Number of columns to display (0 for auto)
config.ls_tweaks_recipe_viewer.fixed_row: Number of rows to display (0 for auto)
